Service Level & Performance Oversight: Driving daily, weekly, and monthly performance reviews with vendor leadership to ensure email, voice, and live chat SLAs, CSAT, and FTR targets are consistently met for German customers. Voice of the German Customer: Gathering local customer insights, market-specific nuances, and recurring trends to advocate for improvements directly with cross-functional business partners. Escalation & Incident Management: Leading the CX response to local incidents and handling high-tier German customer escalations with empathy, local market context, and sound judgment. Resource & Capacity Coordination: Partnering with vendor management on workload forecasting and planning to ensure efficient agent coverage during high-volume promotional periods in Germany. Cross-Departmental Initiatives: Representing the CX function in broader business initiatives to champion a seamless, end-to-end experience for the German audience. 🫵 About You Customer Operations Experience: Solid experience managing customer service or customer experience teams. Vendor Management Experience: Experience managing or working closely with outsourced support partners at scale, with a focus on building strong relationships and driving partner performance. German Market & Channel Expertise: Fluent in German (or deep experience managing support for the German/DACH region) with hands-on experience across multiple support channels (email, voice, and live chat). Metrics & Data-Driven: Confident working with performance metrics (CSAT, FTR, SLAs) and using data to drive decisions and coach partner teams. Cross-Functional Collaborator: A clear and confident communicator who collaborates effectively across internal teams (Product, Marketing, Delivery) and acts as the connective tissue with external partners. Technology-curious: A drive to find technical solutions to improving customer experience, cost and scalability. Balanced Strategy & Execution: Enjoys contributing to broader planning, with a strong focus on hands-on execution. Organized & Predictive: Highly organized, effectively using existing forecasting, planning, and quality control tools to help our teams deliver the best customer experience. Escalations & Pressure: You handle pressure well and are confident in managing incidents and escalations. Customer-Centric: Customer-focused, with a genuine interest in understanding and improving the end-to-end experience for our German audience. Why You’ll Love Working at Omaze Mission: Every day, your work helps raise life-changing funds for vital charities. Growth: Omaze is scaling fast in Germany this is your chance to help shape a new market. Creativity: You’ll help bring surprise, delight, and impact to every conversation. Culture: We’re ambitious, purpose-driven, and believe joy belongs at work too. We are looking for a hands-on Chemical Technical Assistant (CTA) or Lab Technician who takes pride in their lab work. Analytics & Characterization: You are the analytical core of our lab. You routinely perform instrumental and wet-chemical analyses to precisely characterisze our next-generation materials (e.g., NMR, IR spectroscopy, DSC, titrations). Synthesis Execution: You support syntheses (specifically polycondensations) on a bench and pilot scale, reliably and accurately executing reactions according to established standard operating procedures (SOPs). Daily Lab Routine & Excellence: You ensure smooth lab operations. This includes preparing and maintaining glassware, sample preparation, material drying, and general lab organization. Precision & Documentation: You ensure our measurement data is rock-solid. This includes regular calibration of analytical instruments, maintaining detailed lab journals, and assisting in drafting clear SOPs. Safety & Organization: You maintain a safe, high-standard working environment (GLP) and ensure analytical equipment is always ready for the next run. Your profile Education: Successfully completed vocational training as a CTA (Chemical Technical Assistant), Chemielaborant, or a similar technical background. Academic degrees or Techniker qualifications are considered, but this is a hands-on technical role where practical bench experience is our top priority. Analytical Expertise: Strong practical experience in general instrumental and wet-chemical analytics (especially NMR, IR, DSC, titration). Experience in specialized polymer testing (e.g., MFR/MFI, tensile testing) or prior experience in a plastics laboratory is a major plus! Synthesis Experience: Experience in carrying out organic syntheses safely according to protocol (SOPs). Specialized knowledge of polymers or reactors is advantageous, but not mandatory—we are happy to train you. Technical Routine: You feel "at home" in the lab. You are confident operating analytical instruments, preparing samples, and performing routine instrument calibrations. Mindset: You bring a "maker" mentality. You are detail-oriented, reliable, and enjoy the dynamic, collaborative energy of a scaling startup. Languages: Working knowledge of English (sufficient for technical documentation and day-to-day team communication) is required. German is a plus, but not necessary. Why us? Real Impact: Help redesign plastics for a truly circular economy. Startup Mindset: Flat hierarchies, fast decisions and early responsibility as we scale. Team Culture: Join a team of curious minds that challenge each other, collaborate openly and celebrate progress together. Growth & Learning: Steep learning curves, regular feedback and room to grow with the company. Well-being Perks – Hansefit membership and fresh snacks and beverages your overall health and well-being. title: Customer Success Manager (d/w/m)
description: Über uns und unsere Mission: Jahr für Jahr verzichten Millionen von Menschen auf die ihnen zustehende Steuerrückerstattung – viele davon aus Angst vor der Steuererklärung. Taxfix ändert das. Wir möchten es allen ermöglichen, das Thema Steuern und Finanzen in die eigenen Hände zu nehmen. Mit unserer intuitiven App können alle – unabhängig von Bildungsgrad und Hintergrundwissen – die Steuererklärung unkompliziert einreichen. Das Taxfix-Team ist eine Gruppe Problemlöser:innen, die Ideen offen aussprechen und gemeinsam besprechen. Mit Büros in Berlin und Madrid und mehr als 350 Teammitglieder:innen aus über 65 Nationen sind wir reich an vielfältigen Stimmen und Ideen. In sieben Jahren konnten wir mehr als 300 Millionen Euro an Finanzierungsmitteln erhalten und gleichzeitig vielen Menschen dabei helfen, mehr als 3 Milliarden Euro an Steuererstattungen vom Finanzamt zurückzuholen. Was Du bei uns machst: Als Customer Success Manager im Customer Success Team hast Du die Freiheit, von zu Hause oder aus unserem modernen Büro zu arbeiten. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen bei Fragen rund um Taxfix per Chat und E-Mail kompetent, empathisch und verlässlich unterstützt werden. Gemeinsam mit Deinem Team sowie Kolleg:innen aus Operations, Product und weiteren relevanten Bereichen löst Du auch komplexere Anliegen und bringst Kundenfeedback ein, um unsere Customer Experience kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Deine Aufgaben: Du unterstützt unsere Kund:innen bei der Nutzung der Taxfix-App und beantwortest ihre Anfragen per Chat und E-Mail klar, empathisch und lösungsorientiert. Du bearbeitest vielfältige Anliegen rund um die App-Nutzung, technische Funktionen, Zahlungen, steuerliche Themen und Datenschutz. Du löst komplexere oder sensible Fälle selbstständig und leitest sie bei Bedarf mit dem richtigen Kontext an die zuständigen Stellen weiter. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Customer Success Team, internen Operations-Teams und Steuerexpert:innen zusammen, damit unsere Kund:innen zeitnah und zuverlässig unterstützt werden. Du entwickelst Supportprozesse, Vorlagen, Makros und unsere interne Wissensbasis gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter. Du erkennst wiederkehrende Fragen und Verbesserungspotenziale, strukturierst Kundenfeedback und bringst daraus konkrete Impulse für Produkt und Prozesse ein. Du wirkst an teamübergreifenden Projekten und saisonalen Initiativen mit, die unser Service- und Supporterlebnis weiterentwickeln. Das bringst Du mit: Du verfügst über etwa zwei bis drei Jahre Erfahrung im Customer Success, Customer Support, Customer Care oder einem vergleichbaren serviceorientierten Umfeld; Erfahrung aus Hotellerie oder Einzelhandel ist ebenfalls willkommen. Du sprichst und schreibst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse. Du handelst konsequent kundenorientiert und kommunizierst auch bei Beschwerden, Eskalationen oder technischen Problemen klar, empathisch und souverän. Du arbeitest gerne im Team, teilst Wissen proaktiv und trägst zu einer offenen, verlässlichen Zusammenarbeit bei. Du bringst eine lösungs- und prozessorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie ein gutes Gespür für die Qualität schriftlicher Kundenkommunikation mit. Idealerweise hast Du bereits mit CRM- oder Ticketsystemen wie Zendesk, Intercom oder Salesforce gearbeitet; steuerliches Vorwissen ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Du bist neugierig, anpassungsfähig und bereit, neue Produkte, Prozesse und Arbeitsweisen zu erlernen; erste Erfahrungen mit generativer AI sind willkommen. Warum Taxfix? Eine Gelegenheit, bedeutungsvolle, auf Menschen ausgerichtete Arbeit mit einem internationalen Team leidenschaftlicher Fachleute zu verrichten. Ganzheitliches Wohlbefinden mit kostenlosen Coaching-Sitzungen für mentale Gesundheit und Yoga. Ein monatliches Budget, welches Du für eine umfangreiche Palette von Dienstleistungen verwenden kannst. Aktienoptionen für alle Mitarbeitenden – denn alle verdienen es, vom Erfolg zu profitieren! 30 jährliche Urlaubstage und flexible Arbeitszeiten. Hybrides arbeiten sowie bis zu sechs Wochen pro Jahr aus Ausland wenn gewünscht. Stimm Dich einfach mit Deinem Team ab und genieße deine Reise. Viele Möglichkeiten, als Team zu sozialisieren - virtuell und persönlich, wenn möglich. Natürlich kostenlose Steuererklärung durch die Taxfix-App – und interne Unterstützung bei allen persönlichen steuerbezogenen Fragen. Ein großzügiges Weiterbildungsbudget zur Unterstützung Deiner persönlichen und beruflichen Entwicklung sowie Beratung durch unsere internen L&D-Experten. Du hast einen vierbeinigen Freund in Deinem Leben? Wir freuen uns, Hunde bei uns im Büro willkommen zu heißen! Bei Taxfix akzeptieren wir Vielfalt nicht nur - wir feiern sie. Wir sind stolz darauf, dass wir uns für gleiche Beschäftigungschancen einsetzen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Religion, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, Hautfarbe, Behinderung oder Herkunft. Wir schätzen den individuellen Beitrag jeder Person. Schließe dich uns an! Hört sich gut an? Super! Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Data Scientist (m/f/x) 

Location: EU

(Remote) 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Data Scientists who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. Ifyou're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:  

Develop and Deploy Production-Grade AI Systems 

  • Build, deploy, and maintain scalable APIs that serve AI/ML models in production environments 

  • Own end-to-end delivery of AI solutions, from prototyping to fully productionized systems 

Design Advanced AI Architectures 

  • Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems using vector databases 

  • Build and orchestrate AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Evaluate and select appropriate large language models (LLMs) and foundation models based on specific use cases 

Optimize Performance and Scalability 

  • Continuously optimize model inference for latency, cost efficiency, and throughput at scale 

  • Identify bottlenecks and implement improvements to ensure high-performing systems 

Ensure Reliability and Observability 

  • Implement robust monitoring, logging, and alerting for deployed models and services 

  • Ensure system reliability, uptime, and performance through best practices in production ML systems 

Establish Engineering Best Practices 

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for seamless testing, deployment, and iteration of AI systems 

  • Contribute to evolving engineering standards as the company transitions from rapid experimentation to more structured, scalable operations 

Collaborate Cross-Functionally 

  • Work closely with product and engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities into core products 

  • Translate business problems into technical solutions and clearly communicate trade-offs 

Drive Structure in a Fast-Paced Environment 

  • Help bring stability and structure to AI development processes during a high-growth, scale-up phase 

  • Balance speed of execution with the need for maintainable, well-documented, and scalable systems 

  • Take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them through to practical, production-ready outcomes 


Core Experience 

  • 5+ years of experience in Python, with ~10 years of overall software engineering or data experience (candidates transitioning from backend engineering are welcome) 

  • Proven experience building and deploying production-grade APIs (preferably with FastAPI; REST/GraphQL experience is a plus) 

  • Hands-on experience working with large language models (LLMs) and LLMOps, including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation (e.g., GPT, Claude) 

  • Strong experience fine-tuning open-source models (e.g., Hugging Face ecosystem) 

  • Practical experience designing and working with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, pgvector) 

  • Experience building AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Solid understanding of model deployment and serving (e.g., vLLM, TGI, or managed endpoints) 

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices (Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions) 

  • Strong experience working with and processing large-scale text datasets 

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience with MLOps platforms such as MLflow or Weights & Biases 

  • Familiarity with cloud AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI) 

  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects 

  • Experience in the sustainability or climate/product domain 

  • Background in B2B SaaS environments 

  • Prior experience in a startup or scale-up environment (approximately 100–300 employees) 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

Key Attributes 

  • Builder mindset: Comfortable owning systems end-to-end, from experimentation through to production 

  • Bias for action: Operates effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment with shifting priorities 

  • Systems thinker: Designs solutions with scalability, reliability, and maintainability in mind 

  • Pragmatic decision-making: Balances technical excellence with speed and business impact 

  • Ownership & accountability: Takes responsibility for outcomes, not just outputs 

  • Clear communicator: Able to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

 

 

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life.

Mitwirkung an Digitalisierungsprojekten sowie der Weiterentwicklung unserer Payroll-Systemlandschaft mit DATEV Lohn & Gehalt und Personio. Unterstützung beim Aufbau skalierbarer Payroll-Strukturen innerhalb einer stark wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe. Deine Startvoraussetzungen Das bringst Du mit: Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der eigenständigen Entgeltabrechnung sowie fundierte Kenntnisse im Lohnsteuer-, Sozialversicherungs- und Arbeitsrecht sowie praktische Erfahrung mit DATEV Lohn & Gehalt sowie ein sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Payroll-Prozessen. Eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise mit einer Weiterbildung im Bereich Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung, Personalfachkaufleute oder einer vergleichbaren Qualifikation. Eine strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein. Ausgeprägte Dienstleistungsorientierung sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Mitarbeitenden, Führungskräften und internen Fachbereichen. Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch. Das hilft Dir, schneller erfolgreich zu sein: Von Vorteil sind Erfahrungen mit Personio oder vergleichbaren HR-Systemen. Wünschenswert sind Erfahrungen in der Harmonisierung, Standardisierung oder Digitalisierung von Payroll-Prozessen. Hilfreich ist ein Verständnis für Multi-Entity-, Buy-&-Build- oder dynamisch wachsende Unternehmensstrukturen. Von Vorteil sind Erfahrungen in der Zusammenarbeit mit mehreren Gesellschaften sowie unterschiedlichen internen und externen Stakeholdern. Unsere Benefits Attraktives Arbeitsumfeld: Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag in einer krisensicheren und nachhaltig wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe, 30 Tage Jahresurlaub, jeweils ein halber zusätzlicher freier Tag an Heiligabend und Silvester sowie ein hybrides Setup mit einem Home-Office-Tag pro Woche. Dein Arbeitsplatz befindet sich in unserem zentral gelegenen Office in 45659 Recklinghausen. Starke Teamkultur: Eine offene und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur mit regelmäßigen Stand-ups, monatlichen All-Hands Meetings und gemeinsamen Events zur Förderung einer positiven und kollegialen Arbeitsatmosphäre. Verantwortung & Gestaltungsspielraum: Aktive Mitgestaltung und Weiterentwicklung unserer gruppenweiten Payroll-Prozesse sowie die Möglichkeit, Digitalisierung und Harmonisierung nachhaltig voranzutreiben. Payroll-Expertise im Team: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Laura, unserer Lead Payroll, einem erfahrenen Payroll-Team und unseren Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus People Operations. Starkes Wachstumsumfeld: Tätigkeit in einer schnell wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe - unterstützt durch einen der weltweit führenden Investoren, Warburg Pincus. Dieser startet mit einem kurzen Telefonat mit Allen, Sr. Talent Acquisition Partner, gefolgt von einem Video-Call mit Laura, Lead Payroll. Anschließend besteht die Möglichkeit, Christine, VP People sowie das Payroll-Team besser kennenzulernen. Werde Teil unserer spannenden Reise! Wir freuen uns auf Dich! raw.description:
Join Apaleo and Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech!

At Apaleo, we're revolutionizing the hospitality industry with our API-first property management platform, giving businesses the power to build a tech ecosystem that enhances both guest experiences and staff efficiency. With seamless integrations to hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, our platform simplifies operations, elevates the guest journey, and drives revenue growth.

Are you ready to make an impact? We're looking for a Sr. Product Manager Fiscal & Legal (f/m/d) to join our dynamic team and help shape the future of hospitality technology and poised to propel Apaleo into 180+ countries. Be a pivotal part of crafting a fiscal/legal framework that empowers Apaleo to swiftly become compliant in new territories!

What You'll Be Up To 

  • Owning the end to end delivery of one or two product crews within the fiscal and legal domain, for example invoicing or taxation. 
  • Turning roadmap priorities into clear, well scoped work your engineering team can execute against. 
  • Balancing planned roadmap delivery with the steady stream of regulatory and reactive work that comes with keeping Apaleo compliant in markets we've already launched. 
  • Writing clear specs, defining what done looks like and following through on impact analysis so nothing falls through the cracks. 
  • Working shoulder to shoulder with engineering as a technical partner. You'll get into the detail of our API-first architecture rather than handing off a ticket and waiting. 
  • Shielding your team from noise and distractions so they can focus on what matters, whilst keeping delivery predictable. 
  • Partnering with customer success, compliance and engineering stakeholders to understand what's needed and translate it into shippable work. 
  • Helping the team move faster on new country launches, contributing to our ambition of making Apaleo compliant in many more markets over the next few years. 

 

What You'll Bring to the Team 

  • At least 3 to 4 years' experience as a Product Manager, ideally in a fast moving startup or scale up environment. 
  • A strong execution mindset. You're energised by shipping, not just planning, and you take ownership of your product area without needing to be hand held. 
  • Comfort working with technical, API-first products. You can talk architecture with engineers, challenge their thinking and understand what you're shipping in real depth. 
  • Sharp prioritisation instincts. You know how to sequence work, say no to good ideas that aren't great ones, and keep a team focused day to day. 
  • A genuine curiosity for complex domains. You dig into the details rather than staying at the surface, and you're not afraid of a codebase with some history to it. 
  • Clear, confident communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

 

Extra Awesome Points For 

  • Experience with fiscal, tax or legal compliance topics, for example in fintech, e-commerce or ERP systems. This is a genuine nice to have, not a requirement. 
  • Familiarity with platform products where you expose APIs for others to build on. 

 

What We Offer 

  • A diverse, international team. Work alongside passionate people from all sorts of backgrounds, with a genuinely global perspective. 
  • A flat, flexible structure. You'll get real autonomy and ownership, without unnecessary hierarchy in the way. 
  • A key role in a fast growing startup, right in the heart of Munich. 
  • Fair, transparent compensation with a clear peer review and career progression plan. 
  • Flexible working, with hours and remote options that depend on the role. 
  • Team events that are actually fun: cocktail nights, team dinners, meetups and our legendary Oktoberfest celebrations. 
  • 30 days of holiday to properly switch off and recharge. 
  • Free public transport in Munich. Your commute, covered. 

 

How You'll Make an Impact 

Joining Apaleo means more than taking on a role. Your work will directly shape how quickly and reliably we can bring our platform to new markets, and the systems you help build will make life easier for every property that runs on Apaleo. Your voice matters here, and your impact will be easy to see.

title: (Senior) Finance Manager (all genders)
description: At Klim, we work with farmers and food companies to make regenerative agriculture scalable and financially rewarding for farmers. Through our platform, we help farmers restore soil health, increase biodiversity and capture carbon while creating new, reliable income streams. We’re a Berlin-based AgriTech startup backed by $22M in Series A funding, partnering with global food leaders such as Nestlé and Kaufland to reduce emissions across their supply chains and build long-term resilience. Since 2020, we’ve supported 3,500 farmers managing over 900,000 hectares. If you’re passionate about building a sustainable food system and driving real climate impact, join us and help create a healthier planet! Your mission: As our (Senior) Finance Manager, you will run all aspects of Finance at Klim. From HGB accounting and the monthly and annual close, through day-to-day financial operations, to audits, controlling and finance projects — you own the full breadth of the finance function end-to-end. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with unusually broad responsibility: you are the person who keeps our financial engine room running accurately, reliably and on time, and who continuously makes it simpler, faster and more automated. You are supported by a working student whose work you steer, and you report directly to our COO. This role is a great fit for you if you are a finance all-rounder who wants genuine ownership of the entire finance function and the opportunity to make a real impact from day one. With a broad mix of strategic, tactical and operational responsibility, you’ll have plenty of room to shape how we work, improve what’s already there and build an automated Finance function. Your responsibilities: Own our HGB-compliant accounting: run the month-end and year-end close and deliver accurate, timely financial statements with our external accountants. Run financial operations end-to-end: accounts receivable and payable, tax-compliant invoicing, payment runs, expense flows and cash management. Manage statutory reporting and tax topics (e.g. Jahresabschluss / annual financial statements, VAT) together with our external tax advisors. Prepare and manage the annual audit: audit files, documentation and communication with auditors. Support controlling and strategic finance topics: management reporting, analyses and spreadsheet-based models that inform business decisions. Be the driving force behind the introduction of innovative AI-based processes, building a state-of-the-art efficient and effective finance setup. Manage and develop our finance working student. Your profile: 3–5 years of experience in accounting and/or finance roles. Solid HGB accounting experience, including month-end and year-end close. Hands-on experience in financial operations (invoicing, payments, expense management, cash). Very diligent and reliable: high attention to detail, structured, and on top of many short- and long-term deadlines. You are highly autonomous and have a hands-on mentality: you are comfortable owning the full breath of the finance function. You take responsibility for getting things done and you are very good at collaborating with internal and external stakeholders. Experience driving innovation and AI in Finance: You have designed, optimized and automated processes and are confident using AI tools. Fluent in German and English (written and spoken). Your benefits: Opportunity : Be part of our journey from the very beginning, working on an equal footing with the leadership team to build a new company. Impact : Make a daily and active contribution to combating climate change, promoting consumer education, and fostering fair conditions for our climate-conscious farmers. Autonomy : Take ownership of your projects and enjoy a high degree of creative freedom. Flexible work model : At Klim, we foster a flexible, hybrid work approach and facilitate remote work (within the EU). It is advantageous for this role if you live in Berlin or can be present in our office regularly. Additional benefits for Germany-based employees : We offer a subsidy for a membership in Urban Sports Club or the Deutschlandticket, a company pension scheme, plus team lunches (if based in Berlin) and regular team events. At Klim, we believe that a thriving workplace is built on the diverse backgrounds, talents, and perspectives of our team. We grow stronger together by embracing and building on each individual’s unique strengths. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. All hiring and personnel decisions are made solely based on qualifications, performance, and the needs of the company - ensuring fairness and equal opportunity for all. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect fit for our team in ways you don’t yet realize! Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a a Senior Full-stack Engineer to join our engineering team. In Team Decide you'll focus on designing the distributed execution engine that runs customer workflows. You'll own critical systems end-to-end on a team where your decisions shape the product.

What You'll Do

  • Build and operate backend services in Python on AWS — Lambda functions, DynamoDB, Aurora, and event-driven pipelines that handle real production traffic. You'll leverage agentic AI tools as part of your daily workflow.

  • Work on exciting AI initiatives such as MCP servers, agentic co-pilot

  • Tackle hard backend problems — latency, reliability, and scalability are everyday concerns.

  • Own your systems end-to-end: from architecture and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and incident response.

  • Make key architectural decisions — you'll have real authority over how things are built, not just what gets built.

  • Raise the bar for the team through code reviews, mentoring, and improving our development tooling and processes.

  • Work directly with Product and Design to shape what we build next.

Requirements

  • At least 5 years of professional full-stack software engineering experience, with a proven track record of leading complex projects in a senior capacity (2+ years).

  • Deep expertise in React

  • Experience working with Design Systems to ensure a consistent UX among different parts of the product

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to align technical and non-technical stakeholders on a shared vision.

  • The ability to work in a hybrid model from our Berlin HQ, the London office, or the Iasi hub. Please note that relocation assistance is not provided for this role.

Ideal, But Not Required

  • Strong system design skills — you're comfortable making architectural trade-offs and defending them

  • AWS Serverless experience at scale (Lambda, SAM, CloudFormation, DynamoDB, Aurora…)

Our Offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.

  • Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo.

  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.

  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package.

  • Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.

  • Receive a new Apple MacBook Pro, as well as meaningful home office set-up.

Our Stance

  • We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply.

  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears.

Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents.

With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding.

Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo.

With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. Learn more at taktile.com.

description: The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact. Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve: Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register . We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us. 🎯 Your main goal will be to turn n8n's pricing and packaging into a deliberate, data-informed growth lever - one that scales revenue and adoption across our entire go-to-market, from our 1.5 million-strong community to global Enterprise accounts. To do so, here's what you'll own: BUILD THE ANALYTICAL FOUNDATION FOR PRICING Build and own the model connecting unit economics, agent run cost, willingness-to-pay, gross margin, and customer value. Maintain competitive and market intelligence so our pricing keeps pace with a category that's shifting fast. Run pricing experiments and turn the results into documented, reusable learnings. DESIGN OUR PRICING & PACKAGING ARCHITECTURE Shape plan design and packaging across our community, self-serve, and Enterprise tiers, plus add-ons like our startup and charity plans. Design pricing for new SKUs and consumption-based models as our product and cost-to-serve evolve around AI Assistant and n8n Connect. Build packaging frameworks and decision tools that product teams use directly to launch new features. DRIVE AND ROLL OUT PRICING DECISIONS Lead cross-functional pricing decision-making and secure buy-in across Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, RevOps, and Data.   • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to turn n8n's pricing and packaging into a deliberate, data-informed growth lever - one that scales revenue and adoption across our entire go-to-market, from our 1.5 million-strong community to global Enterprise accounts.

BUILD THE ANALYTICAL FOUNDATION FOR PRICING

DESIGN OUR PRICING & PACKAGING ARCHITECTURE

  • Shape plan design and packaging across our community, self-serve, and Enterprise tiers, plus add-ons like our startup and charity plans.

  • Build packaging frameworks and decision tools that product teams use directly to launch new features.

DRIVE AND ROLL OUT PRICING DECISIONS

  • Lead cross-functional pricing decision-making and secure buy-in across Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, RevOps, and Data.

  • 🧮 Deep analytical rigour: You build the financial model yourself and reason fluently about unit economics, cost-to-serve, gross margin, willingness-to-pay, and elasticity.

  • 🔌 Billing fluency, technical and operational: You understand event metering, rating, entitlements, proration, overage, and revenue recognition well enough to design pricing that's actually operable — and you've partnered with a Billing function on invoicing, dunning, true-ups, and disputes.

  • 🛠️ Empathy for technical users and buyers: You understand where, how, and why developers and technical buyers assign value across a product experience.

  • 🧩 Frameworks over bottlenecks: You've built packaging frameworks and decision tools that product teams use independently, rather than routing every pricing decision through you.

Apply now - and help us build the future of automation.

title: Senior Avionics System Engineer
description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation. We are looking for an Avionics Systems Engineer to support the design, development, integration, and validation of spacecraft avionics systems. The role focuses on delivering robust and reliable electronic systems for data handling, communications, and control across all mission phases. The engineer will contribute to system architecture definition, interface management, verification activities, and requirements engineering, while working closely with multidisciplinary teams and external stakeholders. In this role, you might be assigned to different avionics systems of the spacecraft. Key Responsibilities System Design & Architecture Define and develop avionics system architectures , including electronics, data handling, and communication functions. Ensure end-to-end consistency of data flows, interfaces, and system-level requirements . Support selection and definition of avionics equipment, computing platforms, sensors, and communication hardware. Contribute to spacecraft-level trade-offs between performance, reliability, mass, power, and cost. Communications & Data Handling Define onboard and ground-related communication and data handling concepts . Support implementation of telemetry, telecommand, and data distribution architectures. Ensure reliable data acquisition, processing, storage, and transmission under mission constraints. Contribute to bandwidth, timing, and data budget analyses. Integration & Interface Management Define and manage interfaces between avionics and other spacecraft subsystems (power, propulsion, GNC, payload, etc.). Ensure compatibility between spacecraft, launch vehicle, and ground segment interfaces. Coordinate interface definitions with internal teams, suppliers, and external stakeholders. External Regulatory & Certification Leadership Strong ability to technically present, defend, and substantiate avionics subsystem designs and verification evidence with external regulatory and certification authorities, including NASA, ESA, and other government agencies, supporting spacecraft qualification, safety, and flight certification. Verification & Validation Define and support verification and validation strategies for avionics systems. Participate in simulation, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), and system-level testing activities. Analyze test results, identify anomalies, and drive corrective actions. Ensure compliance with system performance and reliability requirements. raw.title: Senior Avionics System Engineer
raw.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.

We are looking for an Avionics Systems Engineer to support the design, development, integration, and validation of spacecraft avionics systems. The role focuses on delivering robust and reliable electronic systems for data handling, communications, and control across all mission phases.

The engineer will contribute to system architecture definition, interface management, verification activities, and requirements engineering, while working closely with multidisciplinary teams and external stakeholders. In this role, you might be assigned to different avionics systems of the spacecraft.

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture

  • Define and develop avionics system architectures, including electronics, data handling, and communication functions.

  • Ensure end-to-end consistency of data flows, interfaces, and system-level requirements.

  • Support selection and definition of avionics equipment, computing platforms, sensors, and communication hardware.

  • Contribute to spacecraft-level trade-offs between performance, reliability, mass, power, and cost.

Communications & Data Handling

  • Define onboard and ground-related communication and data handling concepts.

  • Support implementation of telemetry, telecommand, and data distribution architectures.

  • Ensure reliable data acquisition, processing, storage, and transmission under mission constraints.

  • Contribute to bandwidth, timing, and data budget analyses.

Integration & Interface Management

  • Define and manage interfaces between avionics and other spacecraft subsystems (power, propulsion, GNC, payload, etc.).

  • Ensure compatibility between spacecraft, launch vehicle, and ground segment interfaces.

  • Coordinate interface definitions with internal teams, suppliers, and external stakeholders.

External Regulatory & Certification Leadership

Strong ability to technically present, defend, and substantiate avionics subsystem designs and verification evidence with external regulatory and certification authorities, including NASA, ESA, and other government agencies, supporting spacecraft qualification, safety, and flight certification.

Verification & Validation

  • Define and support verification and validation strategies for avionics systems.

  • Participate in simulation, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), and system-level testing activities.

  • Analyze test results, identify anomalies, and drive corrective actions.

  • Ensure compliance with system performance and reliability requirements.

Requirements Engineering

  • Capture, analyze, and manage system and subsystem requirements.

  • Ensure full traceability from mission objectives to implementation and validation.

  • Contribute to system documentation, including specifications, interface control documents, and test plans.

  • Ensure compliance with applicable space standards and engineering best practices.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with software, hardware, systems, operations, and mission engineering teams.

  • Participate in design reviews, technical exchanges, and system trade-off discussions.

  • Support alignment with external partners, suppliers, and customers.

  • Contribute to integration campaigns, launch preparation, and mission operations support.

Required Qualifications

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or equivalent.

  • +7 years experience in avionics systems, electronics, embedded systems, or spacecraft engineering.

  • Strong understanding of:

    • Electronic and embedded system architectures

    • Communication and data handling principles

    • System integration and interface management

  • Experience with requirements engineering and system lifecycle development.

  • Knowledge of verification and validation methods, including testing and simulation.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work in multidisciplinary engineering environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in spacecraft avionics or aerospace systems.

  • Familiarity with space communication and data standards (e.g., CCSDS).

  • Experience with HIL testing, simulation environments, or digital engineering tools.

  • Exposure to safety-critical or mission-critical system development.

  • Experience working in international or multi-stakeholder engineering teams.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind

raw.description:
About Atira

Atira builds the commercial brain for industrials. Our agents 10x the sales engineers of today by offering the complete toolbox of tasks needed in complex environments. They handle everything from extracting and classifying requirements from incoming RFQs, orchestrating communication and information retrieval across multiple stakeholders and systems, while generating outcomes like documentation, production system inputs, or configuration recommendations. CRM. Atira. ERP.

We are one of the fastest growing teams in Munich and are looking for you to join us!

Why Deployment Strategists are our customers' #1 go-to person

We aim to solve the most complex problems in sales engineering and work closely with customers in mapping out their ideal inbound process. You will dive into our enterprise customers processes to help deploy Atira agents with our FDEs and face their most intricate challenges. You are the go-to person inside our largest partners for anything project management and use case scoping related, and this from the point where you demo our product for the first time up until multi-annual partnership commercial negotiations.
Trust and use case insights are your two most valuable resources you get from customers and what you bring back home will directly shape our core platform in the near future - this requires a strong taste when it comes to how a software product is shaped and a strong opinion on what is needed to maximize customer satisfaction. Beyond that, our Deployment Strategists think beyond a single customer and are essential in figuring out the concrete steps to scale to our next 100 customers by accelerating onboarding processes and increasing customer satisfaction.

What you will do

  • Own the customer end-to-end together with an FDE Tech Lead. From kickoff to renewal, you are on the hook. You run SteerCos, scope deployments, drive onboarding, and decide what gets built next.

  • Scope the agents that work best for a customer You go deep on each customer's technical sales process, understanding it in all it’s details. You bring home whatever solves their problems and conceptualize this across all of your customers

  • Decide what scales and what doesn't. You sit at the boundary between customer work and the core platform. You translate customer behavior into product feedback features and will need to be opinionated on product / our agents

  • Identify, elevate and partner with end users as well as C-Level. You support the internal owner and help scope the long term growth plan.

  • Tell the story. You speak at industry events, co-author case studies, and represent Atira in front of customer executives and prospects. The GTM motion is built around the stories you create

What we are looking for

Ownership, drive, structured thinking, and the ability to thrive in ambiguity and open ended problems. You take problems personally, decide in the absence of a clear roadmap, and own the outcome including the downside.

Your profile

  • Demonstrated ownership and initiative: a company you started, a leading role in a team or larger project

  • 3+ Years customer facing experience working with both end users and C-Level

  • You thrive in customer-facing situations: high-stakes conversations with executives energize you, you push back when needed, and you walk out with a clear next step

  • You’ve optimized your AI tooling: you’ve invested heavily in building the skills and context layer to get the maximum out of your day

  • Relevant coding or strong analytical experience

  • Full working proficiency in both German and English

  • Frontend and app-building / Feature taste

  • Occasional on-site travel per customer requirements; 20-40% overall (DACH primarily, occasionally international)

What you'll get

  • Real ownership: you'll be one of the early team members and shape both product and comapny as well as work closely with customers

  • Strong peers: work with people who have built and shipped AI systems in industrial environments at scale before, and the chance to learn directly from them

  • Impactful work: your code is deployed all across Europe’s and US industrial backbone, affecting how complex products and services are sold and configured worldwide

  • Competitive salary & equity package and additional benefits including Wellpass, JobRad and company dinners

  • Most importantly: Collaborate & thrive in a high-performing but caring culture. We will own the industrial sales function but will do so with modesty and integrity

What success looks like after a few months

  • You independently run enterprise deployments end-to-end, from kickoff to production

  • Customers rely on you as their primary contact and trust your judgment

  • Your learnings have shaped core platform features and the playbook for the customers who come after you

Du bist Profi in der Metallbearbeitung und willst nicht nur ausführen, sondern Verantwortung im Fertigungsprozess übernehmen und dein Team aktiv mit voranbringen

Dann werde Teil der FMA Freitaler Metall und Anlagenbau GmbH

.

FMA - Freitaler Metall- und Anlagenbau GmbH · Poststr. 23 · 01705 Freital

Deine Mission:

In der FMA-Freitaler- Metall- und Anlagenbau GmbH trägst du in der Anarbeitung eine zentrale Verantwortung dafür, dass aus Rohmaterial präzise gefertigte Stahlbauteile entstehen, die die Grundlage für unsere gesamte Schweißbaugruppenfertigung bilden. Du arbeitest nicht nur im Prozess mit, sondern stellst sicher, dass Qualität, Ablauf und Materialfluss stabil funktionieren und unsere Fertigung zuverlässig und effizient läuft. Gemeinsam mit deinem Team sorgst du dafür, dass die Produktion vorbereitet wird und jedes Bauteil in der richtigen Qualität und im richtigen Takt in die nächste Fertigungsstufe geht.


Deine Verantwortung:

  • Operative Fertigung in der Anarbeitung

    Verantwortung für die gesamte operative Vorfertigung in der Anarbeitung als Grundlage für die Schweißbaugruppenfertigung. Dabei arbeitest du aktiv in der Bearbeitung von Stahlbauteilen mit und stellst sicher, dass Qualität, Maßhaltigkeit und Prozessvorgaben eingehalten werden.

  • Teamverantwortung und Mitarbeiterentwicklung in der Anarbeitung

    Fachliche Verantwortung im Tagesgeschäft der Anarbeitung mit aktiver Steuerung der Aufgabenverteilung im Team sowie Sicherstellung eines stabilen Fertigungsablaufs durch kontinuierliche Abstimmung und Unterstützung bei technischen Entscheidungen. Zusätzlich Verantwortung für die strukturierte Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeiter sowie die Förderung fachlicher Kompetenzen und die Entwicklung eigenverantwortlicher Arbeitsweisen im Team mit dem Ziel einer schnellen und nachhaltigen Integration in den Fertigungsprozess.

  • Kontinuierliche Prozessverbesserungen

    Mitwirkung bei der Analyse und Optimierung bestehender Fertigungsprozesse zur Steigerung der Effizienz, Reduktion von Durchlaufzeiten und Verbesserung der Qualität in Abstimmung mit der Fertigungsleitung.

  • Schnittstellenarbeit mit Produktion und Technik

    Enge Abstimmung mit Arbeitsvorbereitung, Produktionsleitung und Qualitätssicherung zur Sicherstellung effizienter Abläufe und termingerechter Fertigung mit hoher Qualität.


Dein Profil:

  • Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im Metallbereich z.B. Industriemechaniker, Konstruktionsmechaniker oder vergleichbar

  • Erfahrung in der Metallbearbeitung und schweißen, sowie im verstehen von technischen Zeichnungen

  • Voraussetzung sind Schweißerpässe (MAG)

  • Erste Erfahrung in fachlicher Anleitung von Mitarbeitern von Vorteil

  • Selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise mit hohem Qualitätsbewusstsein

  • Teamfähigkeit und Bereitschaft in einem leistungsorientierten Umfeld zu arbeiten

  • Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit

  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse C1

  • Stapler- und Kranschein von Vorteil

Unser Angebot:

  • Ein Einstiegsgehalt zwischen 17€ und 19€ brutto pro Stunde

  • Überdurchschnittliche betriebliche Altersvorsorge: 50€ von uns + 50% Entgeltumwandlung

  • Fahrtkostenzuschüsse, kostenlose Parkplätze, ÖPNV-Jobticket

  • Vollzeit: 39h Woche

  • Regelmäßige Mitarbeiterevents, Feedback- und Zielgespräche

  • Angenehmes Arbeitsumfeld mit familiärer Teamkultur

  • Aufstiegs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

  • 30 Tage Urlaub 

  • Kostenlose Arbeitskleidung und Reinigung


Die Veaxo Gruppe entstand durch die Zusammenführung von vier renommierten Metallbauunternehmen. Mit über 100 Mitarbeitern an vier Standorten versorgen wir mittelständische und Großindustriekunden mit hochwertigen Metallprodukten und Dienstleistungen im Industriebereich. Jedes Unternehmen der Gruppe verfügt über spezifische Kernkompetenzen im Metall- und Servicebereich und erweitert das Produktangebot von Veaxo.

Die FMA - Freitaler Metall- und Anlagenbau GmbH ist Teil dieser Unternehmensgruppe und spezialisiert sich als idealer Ansprechpartner für Stahlbau, Metallbau und Anlagenbau in verschiedenen Branchen. Unser Portfolio umfasst sowohl standardisierte als auch maßgeschneiderte Lösungen, darunter die Sonderanfertigung von Kranen, Montage, Instandhaltungs- und Reparaturarbeiten. Unsere Expertise erstreckt sich außerdem auf den Stahlbau, mit Aufträgen im Behälterbau, der Fertigung von einbaufertigen Bauteilen und dem Brennschneiden.

Bei uns findest du nicht nur eine berufliche Heimat, sondern auch eine angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre. Wir pflegen eine „Unternehmenspolitik der offenen Tür“, führen regelmäßige Beurteilungs- und Feedbackgespräche sowie Team- und Abteilungsrunden für den fachlichen Austausch durch. Wir glauben fest daran, dass unsere auf individuellen Stärken aufbauende Unternehmenskultur der Schlüssel zum Erfolg ist.


Wenn du auch nach einer anspruchsvollen Position suchst, in der du deine Fähigkeiten ausbauen und Teil eines stahlharten Teams werden kannst, ist die FMA der richtige Ansprechpartner für dich!

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (all genders)
description: Sunday Natural is one of Germany’s fastest-growing natural health brands, and our eCommerce platform is growing with it – today it serves 7 million monthly active users , runs on €400k of AWS per year , and supports a development organization of 30+ engineers . Every one of those numbers has moved sharply upward in the last few years, and all of them will keep moving. You would be our first dedicated in-house Senior DevOps Engineer – and the two biggest engineering projects of the next two years are yours to help define and drive: bringing our entire infrastructure under Terraform, and strengthening the scalability, security and compliance posture across our cloud environments. Your role You shape the infrastructure vision. How we run, deploy, monitor and scale is yours to define, propose and defend. You work alongside our two external partners as the in-house technical counterpart – building the architecture and standards together, and bringing the deep platform knowledge back into the company. As the platform grows, taking the technical direction of that group is a natural next step, and one we would actively support. You own our AWS spend – €400k a year that currently has no dedicated owner, including where it goes and how we bring it down. You are the escalation point. When production is at risk, you decide. You report directly to the Head of eCommerce Platforms , with direct access to leadership for the decisions that need it. What you'll own AWS infrastructure – EC2, RDS, Fargate, CloudFront, S3, IAM – plus Cloudflare, DNS and WAF Security & compliance – DevSecOps practices, system audits, patching and access reviews, and GDPR-compliant data handling across every environment Infrastructure as code – taking us from manually managed to fully Terraform-defined Data layer – MySQL under production load: tuning, replication, and backups you have actually restored from Cloud economics – a €350k annual AWS budget with real headroom for optimisation Delivery for 30+ developers – Bitbucket Pipelines, environments, and how fast and safely code reaches production Reliability at 7M MAU – monitoring, logging, alerting and incident response (New Relic, Sentry, CloudWatch, PagerDuty) Your profile 7+ years running production infrastructure , with deep hands-on AWS as the person accountable when it breaks Security-conscious infrastructure operations – DevSecOps practices, system audits and access reviews, comfortable being accountable for GDPR-relevant data handling Infrastructure as code at scale – Terraform as your default way of working, on an estate of comparable size Deep Linux (Debian/Ubuntu) – you can trace a slow system from the kernel up and explain what you found MySQL under real load – slow-query analysis, replication, indexing, tested recovery Ownership of monitoring and incident response at scale – description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at&nbsp;<a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><p><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></p> <p>CoreWeave’s Physical AI team is building the essential cloud platform for AI innovators, applying machine learning to solve previously intractable physics and engineering challenges. We operate at the intersection of advanced cloud infrastructure, artificial intelligence, and applied data science, transforming how complex industrial products - such as automotive systems, aircraft, robotics, advanced manufacturing systems, and batteries - are conceived, tested, and developed.</p> <p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>As a Staff Product Manager, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for one of the core components of our Physical AI platform. We're rebuilding the platform from the ground up, so you'll shape the product from day one. You'll drive execution across Research, Data Science, Engineering, and Forward Deployed Engineering to ship capabilities spanning agentic experiences, applied AI workflows, and enterprise integrations. You will work closely with enterprise customers to understand complex engineering and industrial workflows, identify where emerging AI technologies can create meaningful value, turn field signals into scalable platform improvements, and mentor other product managers across the organisation while setting a high bar for technical depth, product judgement, and customer empathy.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Run discovery in the field, and spend time in front of customers</li> <li>Decide what we build. You’ll take a candidate product from problem to validated concept; use case, customer proof points, and the business case for continuing or stopping</li> <li>Ship products in a small squad, setting roadmap and sequencing work required.</li> <li>Keep cross-functional stakeholders aligned. For the products you own: a one-line pitch, short summary and demo that anyone in the company can follow - what it is, why we’re building it, what’s next.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Who You Are:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Significant experience across product management, product strategy, technical programme leadership, or related roles, with a strong track record of turning complex technologies into products, platforms, or customer outcomes.</li> <li>High versatility with a proven ability to work across multiple technical domains, such as ML modelling, generative AI, agentic workflows, robotics, advanced manufacturing, cloud infrastructure, or data engineering.</li> <li>Strong technical fluency with the ability to confidently discuss APIs, architecture diagrams, deployment models, AI systems, and platform trade-offs with engineers, researchers, and technical customers.</li> <li>Demonstrated cross-functional leadership, skilled at aligning diverse teams across Product, Engineering, Research, Data Science, and commercial functions while managing technical dependencies and balancing constraints with business objectives.</li> <li>Deep customer empathy with a curiosity for understanding complex engineering and industrial workflows, diagnosing friction points, and identifying where new technologies can fundamentally improve how customers work.</li> <li>Absolute execution focus with a proven ability to build clarity out of ambiguity, move comfortably between strategy and hands-on delivery, maintain high attention to detail, and drive initiatives from concept through execution.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Background in engineering, physical research, robotics, advanced manufacturing, or applied data science, including experience working with physical systems, industrial environments, sensor data, or complex engineering workflows.</li> <li>Familiarity with generative AI, machine learning, or cloud infrastructure platforms such as AWS, GCP, Azure, or CoreWeave, and experience translating emerging technologies into real-world customer applications.</li> <li>Experience with AI-assisted coding or prototyping tools; our PMs are builders first and regularly use technology to explore ideas, validate concepts, and accelerate product development.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wondering if you're a good fit?</strong></p> <p>We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. We recognise that some of the strongest Physical AI product leaders have moved between product, engineering, research, strategy, programme leadership, and industry. Here are a few qualities we've found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we'd love to talk.</p> <ul> <li><strong>You love to</strong> build clarity out of complexity and champion high-impact technical products from concept to launch.</li> <li><strong>You're curious about</strong> emerging Physical AI technologies, generative AI, agentic workflows, robotics, and how they can be applied to transform real-world industrial and engineering challenges.</li> <li><strong>You're an expert in</strong> cross-functional execution, seamlessly connecting the dots between deeply technical engineering and research teams, enterprise customers, and commercial priorities.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></h3> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We're in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We're not afraid of a little chaos, and we're constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Be Curious at Your Core</strong></li> <li><strong>Act Like an Owner</strong></li> <li><strong>Empower Employees</strong></li> <li><strong>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</strong></li> <li><strong>Achieve More Together</strong></li> </ul> <p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organisation's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!</p> <p>The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance&nbsp;</li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution&nbsp;</li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary&nbsp;</li> <li>Critical Illness Cover&nbsp;</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme&nbsp;</li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><em>CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.</em></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Recruitment Agencies</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em><em data-stringify-type="italic">CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms &amp; Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void.</em></em></span></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em data-stringify-type="italic">Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party.</em></span></em></p> <p><strong>Export Control Compliance</strong></p> <p>This position requires access to export controlled information. &nbsp;To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency. &nbsp;CoreWeave may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><em>Updated privacy notice - UK and EU Job Applications&nbsp;</em></strong></p> <p><em>When you apply to a job on this site, the personal data contained in your application will be collected by CoreWeave UK Ltd. (“Controller”), which is located at</em></p> <p><em>Phosphor (6th Floor), 133 Park Street, London, SE1 9EA</em></p> <p><em>and can be contacted by emailing ----- Controller’s data protection officer can be contacted at ----- Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of managing Controller’s recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes. Such processing is legally permissible under Art. 6(1)(f) of (i) Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation (“GDPR”) and (ii) the GDPR as it forms part of the laws of the UK (“UK GDPR”), as necessary for the purposes of the legitimate interests pursued by the Controller, which are the solicitation, evaluation, and selection of applicants for employment. Your personal data will be shared with Greenhouse Software, Inc., a cloud services provider located in the United States of America and engaged by Controller to help manage its recruitment and hiring process on Controller’s behalf. With respect to transfers originating from the UK or the European Economic Area ("EEA") to a country outside the UK or the EEA, we implement the appropriate transfer mechanism(s) and other appropriate solutions to address cross-border transfers as required by applicable law. You may request a copy of the suitable mechanisms we have in place by contacting us at </em><a ---------- <p><em>Your personal data will be retained by Controller as long as Controller determines it is necessary to evaluate your application for employment. Where permitted by applicable law, we may also retain your personal data for a limited period after the recruitment process ends in order to consider you for future job opportunities, respond to legal claims, or comply with record-keeping obligations. Under the GDPR and the UK GDPR, you have the right to request access to your personal data, to request that your personal data be rectified or erased, and to request that processing of your personal data be restricted. You also have the right to data portability. In addition, you may lodge a complaint with the relevant supervisory authority: (i) A list of Europe’s data protection authorities can be found </em><a href="https://urldefense.com/v3/__https://ec.europa.eu/justice/article-29/structure/data-protection-authorities/index_en.htm__;!!I6uDfDBXfA!zaqvpaXitCAqve4cpmPGknjMlTsgIw8w_6xTVeiRpNP5Eo6Ajz9ZkXAYM2uL-nlD8kD6Ndd-Oe-k_BEQQh9xVQGfFw$"><em>here</em></a><em>; and (ii) for the UK, this is the </em><a href="https://urldefense.com/v3/__https://ico.org.uk/__;!!I6uDfDBXfA!zaqvpaXitCAqve4cpmPGknjMlTsgIw8w_6xTVeiRpNP5Eo6Ajz9ZkXAYM2uL-nlD8kD6Ndd-Oe-k_BEQQh9IDhJOUA$"><em>Information Commissioner's Office</em></a><em>.</em><em>&nbsp;</em></p> <p><em>For additional information, please see our </em><a href="https://docs.coreweave.com/docs/policies/terms-of-service/privacy-policy"><em>Privacy Policy</em></a><em>.</em></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; color: #662d91;">Teamwork makes the stream work.</h2> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Roku is changing how the world watches TV</strong></h3> <p>Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p> <p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><h3 class="mt-6 mb-2 font-semibold text-xl" data-streamdown="heading-3"><span class="font-semibold" data-streamdown="strong">What does the team work on?</span></h3> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">Roku's Automation support and Tools team focuses on providing innovative, impactful tools and SW solutions including AI enabled engineering capabilities to help accelerate validation efforts, improve efficiency, enhance productivity of all engineering team across Roku's entire embedded SW org. The team works across full-stack applications, backend services, and scalable platform services to improve developer productivity, end-to-end testing experience of Roku products and services. You will be joining a talented, high-performance team of developers with a strong delivery culture. We are looking for someone who can help us keep up this pace and continue delivering high quality as we grow.</p> <h3 class="mt-6 mb-2 font-semibold text-xl" data-streamdown="heading-3"><span class="font-semibold" data-streamdown="strong">What is the role?</span></h3> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">Roku is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Embedded Software Automation and Tools team to build full stack applications and services that support end-to-end automation and test infrastructure. This role involves designing and delivering full stack solutions that support cross-functional internal and external stakeholders across the Roku ecosystem. You will contribute across frontend and backend systems, with a strong focus on performance, reliability, and scalability. You will build and evolve APIs and microservices, and help integrate modern AI capabilities into production experiences where they add clear user value. The role requires strong technical judgment, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to move from concept through delivery in a fast-paced environment.</p> <h3 class="mt-6 mb-2 font-semibold text-xl" data-streamdown="heading-3"><span class="font-semibold" data-streamdown="strong">How will I use AI at Roku?</span></h3> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. We use AI agents and smart tooling across brainstorming, planning, analysis, and implementation. People set the direction, exercise judgment, and own the outcomes.</p> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agentic frameworks — and can describe projects where you shipped real customer-facing work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, validate its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.</p> <h3 class="mt-6 mb-2 font-semibold text-xl" data-streamdown="heading-3"><span
